item.title: PyPad 1.7.9-prerelease
item.description: - HTML export now preserves markdown structure as real HTML elements (headings/lists/links/code). - Added Demo Pack markdown templates under File > Templates > Demo Pack (new + insert actions). - Added Help > Open Demo Pack (first template) one-click launcher. - First-time tutorial now recommends trying the Demo Pack. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
